It will be a good read for anyone interested in understanding the future play of technology and humanity.

occurrences.title: Where are the Customers' Yachts?
occurrences.author: Leo Gough
occurrences.imageTitle: Fred Schwed's Where are the Customers' Yachts?: A modern-day interpretation of an investment classic
occurrences.imageAlt: Fred Schwed's Where are the Customers' Yachts? - Leo Gough
occurrences.description: Navigate the world of Wall Street with a funny and insightful critique of Wall Street and the financial industry at large. This really puts in perspective the value that financial professionals actually deliver for their clients. Perhaps, more than anything, it is most famous for summarizing the disparity between the wealth of the former group and, all too often, the less fortunate outcomes for the latter. With humor and wisdom, it exposes the foolishness and hypocrisies of investment professionals and gives advice to individual investors on how they can defend their own interests in a system which appears to be meant to favor insiders. It is a reminder for all times how should an investor go into counsel warily, with a priority to be clear where the interests really are.
